item: Row 288 batch 8: the last 25 convertible test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 29 bare engine calls in 25 test files move to tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine: the sa.create_engine form and helpers that took a sqlite URL (now a path). Converted files and the three test files importing them pass (685). test_concentration_bounded_reads.py and test_source_article_counts.py stay bare because their seeds or subject are rows without a parent (a source with no row; mentions of article ids no article holds). The ratchet ceiling goes from 70 to 41 calls in 23 files; what remains is held by R781, R782 or R785, the SQLCipher-leg family, tests whose subject is orphan rows or a non-WAL journal, test_rollup_scan_plan.py (DuckDB) and files touched by open PRs. Test-only, no release line.
